# ISyrupWithdrawalManagerV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/syrup/ISyrupWithdrawalManagerV2.sol)


## Functions
### requestIds

Returns the last request id for a given owner.
Function must exist for backwards compatibility with the old implementation where we supported only one
request per owner.


```solidity
function requestIds(address owner) external view returns (uint256 requestId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|         The account to check the last request id for.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId`|`uint256`|     The id of the last valid withdrawal request for the account.|


### requests

Returns the owner and amount of shares associated with a withdrawal request.


```solidity
function requests(uint256 requestId) external view returns (address owner, uint256 shares);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId`|`uint256`|Identifier of the withdrawal request.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|    Address of the share owner.|
|`shares`|`uint256`|   Amount of shares pending redemption.|


### userEscrowedShares

Returns the amount of shares escrowed for a specific user yet to be processed.


```solidity
function userEscrowedShares(address owner) external view returns (uint256 escrowedShares);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|         The address of the owner of shares.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`escrowedShares`|`uint256`|Amount of shares escrowed for the user.|
